status: Unpublished proposal. No website files changed.
name: PaperBuild
accessLabel: Free up to 10 pages + optional paid Pro
description: Turn captured or selected images into a PDF on your Android phone, with manual cropping, page styles and a private Recent PDFs library.
features: Add images or capture pages with your camera app
Crop, reorder and rotate up to 10 pages per document for free
Choose A4 or US Letter with colour, grayscale or contrast treatment
Open, share or save finished PDFs, and find them in a private local library
proDescription: Optional PaperBuild Pro is a one-time Google Play purchase for smaller exports, more pages, PDF merge and extraction, protected output, watermarks, page numbers and saved presets. No subscription. Your local price is shown before purchase.
limitation: Not OCR, automatic edge detection, PDF text editing or secure redaction. Review readability before sharing. Export important copies before uninstalling. PDF tools do not accept protected inputs; output passwords do not encrypt source images or drafts. Forgotten passwords cannot be recovered.
tutorialHeading: Make a PDF from page photos on Android
tutorialDescription: Follow the free image import, manual crop, PDF export and Recent PDFs workflow with genuine app screenshots.
publicationPrerequisites: Add PaperBuild to src/data/apps.ts and the article app schema enum
Copy the original current home screenshot and existing icon into public/apps/paperbuild
Resolve the app template's hard-coded privacy route: publish an approved faithful policy page or explicitly support the current external policy URL
Add a PaperBuild-only tutorial link to its app page
Add approved article and five images; check Updates, RSS, sitemap and relevant tests
